item.title: Some of Warner Bros. Games' 'biggest franchises' to return starting next year, Netflix backs out of bidding war with Paramount
item.description: <p>Things have been very interesting in the world of Warner Bros. for a number of months now, and that doesn't seem to be slowing down any time soon.</p> <p>Warner Bros. Discovery held their latest earning conference call today where they talked a bit about what's in their future for gaming, and then came a big update on the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/05/mortal-kombat-netflix-acquisition/">bidding tug of war for the corporation between Netflix and Paramount</a>.</p>

item.title: Bride and groom compete against each other in Soul Calibur 2 during their wedding celebration
item.description: <p>It's been nearly 24 years since Soul Calibur 2 was released. Though there have been many iterations that came after it, many fans still see the second entry as the best of the series.</p> <p>As it turns out, there's a newly wed couple that seemingly believe this to be so. During their big day, they decided to sit down at some arcade cabinets and compete against one another in Soul Calibur 2.</p>

item.title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves: Legend Edition already offering first sale including the Season Pass 2 DLC
item.description: <p>It's only been around a month since <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/ffcotw/">Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves</a> began their second season, and you can already save some money on the full package.</p> <p>To coincide with the release of <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/19/nightmare-geese-trailer-fatal-fury/">Nightmare Geese</a>, SNK is putting their new Legend Edition of Fatal Fury on sale.</p>

item.title: Tekken 8 Season 3 balance update plans and direction details revealed where they plan to go 'back to basics'
item.description: <p>It may be a bit wild to think that <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/tekken8/">Tekken 8</a> has been out for over two years already, and the third season is right around the corner.</p> <p>Today, Bandai Namco revealed a more detailed overview of what to expect in the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/01/blank-revealed-start-season-3-tekken-8/">Tekken 8 Season 3</a> balance update coming in March.</p>
